# OG Technologies EU

> OG Technologies EU provides technical expertise at the intersection of payment infrastructure, DLT, digital identity and international standards.

## Products

- [EduNode](https://www.ogtechnologies.co/products/): Education platform built on Web3 technology
- [Mozart Pay](https://www.ogtechnologies.co/products/): Payment infrastructure solution

## Services

- [IT Consulting](https://www.ogtechnologies.co/quote/): Request a quote for consulting and software development
- [Standards Consulting](https://www.ogtechnologies.co/standards/): ISO, CEN, EBSI standards expertise
- [DORA Compliance](https://www.ogtechnologies.co/dora/): Digital Operational Resilience Act compliance
